description: Search funding rounds (the same feed as app.fundz.net/fundings). Filter by company name, industry, location (city/state/country), keywords, series, amount and date window, or run one of the user's saved filters by name. Page through every match with page, and get only new rounds with since. Filters are applied server-side, so the total_count is the filtered total.

days.description: Number of days to look back (default 7)

industry.description: Industry title as used in Fundz, e.g. "Information Technology", "Financial Services", "Health Care"

keywords.description: Free-text keywords matched against the round's title and description, e.g. "fintech", "artificial intelligence"

location.description: City, state/region or country title, e.g. "Colorado", "United States", "Denver", "United Kingdom"

min_money_raised.description: Minimum amount raised (in dollars, e.g., 1000000 for $1M)

new_since_last_pull.description: Only rows this account has not already been shown by an earlier new_since_last_pull call with the same filters. Fundz remembers per account and filter set, so a daily agent run gets just what is new, with no dates to track. The first call returns the normal window (days or since) and starts the marker. Ignores page: if more new rows are waiting the reply says so; call again the same way for the next batch. Needs a signed-in account.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1 (default 1). Each page holds `limit` results; the reply ends with the total and next_page when there are more.

saved_filter.description: Name of one of the user's saved filters (see get_saved_filters); its criteria are applied and any explicit filters above are added on top

since.description: Only results Fundz added on or after this ISO date, e.g. "2026-10-01" (whole day, so a daily run may repeat that day). Overrides days. Use the date of your last run to get only what is new.

name: search_funding_rounds
title: Search funding rounds
